name: Avatar
summary: A person, organisation, team or bot as a picture, their initials or an icon, in one of 13 sizes. The picture falls back to initials on a colour the name picks from the category set (the same colour wherever that name appears), then to an icon for the kind. People are circles; organisations, teams and bots are rounded squares. Presence, a state (verified, approved, declined, warning) and a count come through Badge, sized with the avatar; an activity ring shows someone speaking or typing now. Many people: AvatarGroup; with their name beside it: Persona.
a11y: `role="img"` named by the name plus its presence, state, count and activity in words ("Ana Ruiz, Busy, 3 new"); the badges inside are not read again. `decorative` hides it when the name is written beside it. With `onClick` or `href` it is a button or link with the same name and a focus ring outside the activity ring. The colour never carries meaning: it only tells people apart, and the initials keep 4.5:1 on it in every context.

props.name: name
props.description: Who or what it is, in full ("Ana Ruiz", "Contoso"). Gives the initials, the colour and the accessible name.

props.name: src
props.description: A picture. While it loads the initials show; if it fails they stay, so the avatar is never empty.

props.name: kind
props.description: `person` (default) is a circle; `organisation`, `team` and `bot` (any automated agent) are rounded squares, so people and the things they belong to never read the same.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixels, from 16 (inline in text) to 128 (a profile editor). 24, 36, 44, 48, 56, 64 and 80 match the control sizes xs to xxl, so an avatar sits level with a control beside it. Default 32.

props.name: initials
props.description: Override the initials, e.g. for a name whose initials aren't its first letters.

props.name: category
props.description: Override the colour, 1-8 (`color.category.*`). By default the name picks one, the same everywhere it appears.

props.name: presence
props.description: A person's availability, shown with Badge's presence shapes at the bottom-end corner.

props.name: status
props.description: A state on the avatar (verified, approved, declined, warning) at the same corner; it replaces presence.

props.name: count
props.description: A count of new things for this person (unread messages), pinned to the top-end corner.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Words for `count` ("3 unread messages"). Default "{count} new".

props.name: activity
props.description: Something they're doing now ("Speaking", "Typing", "New story"): draws the activity ring and adds the words to the name.

props.name: loading
props.description: The person is still loading: a placeholder of the same size and shape.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide it from assistive technology because the name is written right beside it (Persona, a list row).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes it a button (open a profile card, change the photo); the name says what it opens.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes it a link to the person's or entity's page.
